title: HBO Max Has Removed One of Its Strangest Anime Originals
content: In the streaming game these days, it can sometimes feel like no movie and/or television series is safe. Aside from properties often playing leapfrog when it comes to platforms, there are unfortunate scenarios where certain projects leave streaming entirely.
author: ComicBook

title: This Summer 2026 Anime Proves Kagurabachi Could Be 2027’s Most Visually Striking Anime
content: Kagurabachi has become one of the biggest sensations in the anime and manga world, with fans hoping to see an anime adaptation even before the first chapter was released back in 2023. Three years later, an anime adaptation of the series was finally announced, with the anime set to premiere in April 2027.
author: ComicBook

title: Madhouse Reveals 'ghost' Original Anime Film's Teaser, Full Title, February 11, 2027 Debut
content: The official website for Madhouse 's new theatrical anime project, tentatively titled ghost, opened on Wednesday and revealed the film's official title ghost – end of night ( ghost/yoru no hate ), early teaser trailer, first key visual, musical composer, and February 11, 2027 opening in Japan.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Soara to Mamono no Ie' Receives TV Anime Adaptation in 2027
content: Production company Kadokawa opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Hidenori Yamaji 's Soara to Mamono no Ie ( Soara and the House of Monsters ) manga on Wednesday, revealing the main cast, staff, an ultra teaser visual (pictured), and ultra teaser promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Eris Begins Her Training in Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 1 & Episode 2 Preview
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 1 and Episode 2 preview images ahead of their July 5 premiere. Crunchyroll will be streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup . The new season is set to begin with the Eris Training Arc , focusing on her journey after leaving Rudeus behind.
author: Anime Corner

content: Kadokawa announced on Wednesday the television anime adaptation of Hidenori Yamaji 's Soara and the House of Monsters ( Soara to Mamono no Ie , the anime uses the English title Soara and Monster's House ) manga, and revealed the anime's ultra teaser promotional video, ultra teaser visual, main cast and staff members,…

title: Soara and the House of Monsters TV Anime Announced for 2027, First Trailer and Main Cast Revealed
content: Hidenori Yamaji’s fantasy manga Soara and the House of Monsters is officially getting a TV anime adaptation, with the release date set for 2027. The announcement was made with an ultra teaser visual, the first teaser trailer, and the reveal of the anime’s main cast and staff.
author: Anime Corner

title: Shueisha's Contract for Manga of Marvel Characters Ends on September 30
content: Shueisha announced on Wednesday that its contract with Walt Disney Japan to publish manga adaptations of Marvel Comics characters will end on September 30. Shueisha will begin removing the below manga titles from digital storefronts gradually from September 28 to 30, and is ceasing the sales of the same manga titles…

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 1 Begins Streaming Worldwide on Netflix
content: Netflix has added That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (TenSura) Season 1 to its global catalog, making the first season of Rimuru Tempest’s isekai adventure available to subscribers worldwide. The announcement was made through the platform’s official social media channels on June 30.
author: Anime Corner

title: Saga of Tanya the Evil II Anime's 2nd Trailer Previews Theme Songs, Reveals New Cast Member
content: Kadokawa revealed on Wednesday the second main promotional video and a new cast member for Saga of Tanya the Evil II ( Yōjo Senki II ), the second season based on author Carlo Zen and illustrato Shinobu Shinotsuki 's light novel series. The video previews the previously announced opening theme song "Why?
